violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -An unorganized mound of food product/boxes are stored on the floor of the freezer.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -A box of ToGo boxes and box of coffee cup lids are being stored on the floor of the dry storage room.
Lighting. — --Light intensity for walk-in refrigeration or food storage area was insufficient. -The freezer does not have a working light fixture at the time of inspection.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -The mop is stored in the mop bucket unable to air dry when not in use.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Milk on the floor of the walk in cooler and multiple boxes of food on the floor of the walk in freezer. Keep off of the floor 6"
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
